Linear Regression.

Fits ordinary least squares from numeric table columns and appends Float32 prediction and residual columns.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `LinearRegressionNode` |
| Search words | linear, regression |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Table containing numeric predictor and target columns |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Fitted** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus Float32 prediction and residual columns |
| **Model** | Parameters | No | 1 | Reusable fitted linear-regression artifact |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Predictor columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric predictor columns. Required. |

| Fit Options | Fit intercept | `fit_intercept` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Include a fitted intercept term. |
